items.text:
I'm 300+ hours in and love the sandbox nature of the game [u]except[/u] the [spoiler]mystery meat[/spoiler] plot line. The social needs and pirates are annoying; I wish I could turn them off or adjust them.

I was enjoying the game with everything as expected, then suddenly forced to play a game in a different genre and not what I thought I bought.

I'm sure some others will find it fun and amusing. For me it was frustrating. It ruined immersion. It wasted my time. The plot line disregarded what had been well honored player agency, taking the game a direction I didn't want, without choice. My first character and run immediately felt like it was no longer mine.

Up to that point I had been able to choose what plots to engage in and ignore others. This one's different. I didn't choose it. It appeared and forced me to make an IRL choice ([spoiler]because there was self-replicating meat in my airlock[/spoiler]): slog through content that's not fun for me, or re-load a save wasting hours of my time. That choice became necessary because there wasn't a way for me to easily choose whether or not to engage with the plot without detracting from my enjoyment.

I found buried in patch notes, the commands to restrict it, but that's not good enough. Having to interrupt what was otherwise fun to search out how to make it stop is not a player focused solution. More IRL time lost in which I could have been having fun.

I still recommend the game for those not bothered by the supernatural content tainting the space sim or willing to disable it.
items.text_zh:
我已经玩了300多个小时，很喜欢这款游戏的沙盒性质，[u]除了[/u]那条[spoiler]神秘肉[/spoiler]剧情线。社交需求和海盗很烦人；我希望我能关掉它们或调整它们。

我原本一切如预期地享受这款游戏，然后突然被迫玩一个不同类型、并非我以为自己买下的游戏。

我相信有些人会觉得它有趣好玩。对我来说，这很令人沮丧。它破坏了沉浸感。它浪费了我的时间。这条剧情线无视了此前一直被很好尊重的玩家自主权，把游戏带向我并不想要的方向，而且没有选择。我的第一个角色和存档立刻感觉不再属于我了。

在那之前，我一直能够选择参与哪些剧情、忽略哪些剧情。这一条不一样。我没有选择它。它出现了，并强迫我做出一个现实中的选择（[spoiler]因为我的气闸里有自我复制的肉[/spoiler]）：硬着头皮玩对我来说不好玩的内容，或者重新读取存档、浪费我数小时的时间。这个选择之所以变得必要，是因为我没有办法轻松选择是否参与这条剧情，同时又不损害我的乐趣。

我在补丁说明里翻到了限制它的命令，但这还不够好。不得不打断本来很有趣的游戏去查找如何让它停止，这不是以玩家为中心的解决方案。又浪费了更多我本可以用来享受乐趣的现实时间。

我仍然推荐这款游戏给那些不被这种污染太空模拟的超自然内容困扰、或者愿意禁用它的人。

observations.description: 神秘肉剧情线强制玩家参与，无法选择忽略
observations.evidence: I was enjoying the game with everything as expected, then suddenly forced to play a game in a different genre and not what I thought I bought.
observations.evidence_zh: 我本来正按预期享受着游戏的一切，然后突然被迫去玩一个完全不同类型的游戏，而不是我以为自己买的那款。
